name: Incline Y-Raise
research: Same body-on-bench as chest_supported_reverse_fly: bench 30 deg rot_z 180, root rot X +60, pelvis joint at pad s=0.30 + 0.17 m along the pad normal = (0,-0.166,0.732). LEGS (12 Nov fix; old straddle splayed the knees to the floor): knees on the seat, the bench's other common set-up (Sweat: 'knees resting on the seat or feet planted on either side'). FK check with the 30 deg pad and the seat boxes: a feet-on-floor stance under the hips cannot clear the pad without the thighs splaying 40+ deg, so kneel. Hip (+-0.11,-0.194,0.689) -> knee (0.105,0.218,0.49) on the seat (thigh 0.457, 25 deg knee bend, thigh clears the pad by 3.4 cm) -> ankle (0.10,0.666,0.4685): shin lies on the seat top (0..-5 mm), feet hang past the seat end, toes down-back (rot X 120). Knee pole straight below (world). Lowest body point is now the toes (~0.25-0.3 m), on purpose. Camera yaw -50 / pitch 35 (front-right, high): arms spread across the picture instead of pointing at the lens, and the back faces the camera.
